raw_text: Reports of a cyber attack on ISRO's Bengaluru data centre are circulating. Apparently spear-phishing emails impersonating ISRO officials were used. The timing right after Chandrayaan-3's successful landing seems deliberate. Anyone have details on whether mission control systems were actually compromised or just the administrative network?
clean_text: Reddit discussion on cyber attack targeting ISRO Bengaluru data centre via spear-phishing after Chandrayaan-3 landing. Questions about extent of compromise.
